declared difference (truth fix T3, recovery shapes): `location.href ==` (a comparison) counted as an href recovery,
so Cmp's poll was NOT-KEYED instead of having no recovery, and `location.reload ( )` with a blank before "(" was not
a reload, so Space's poll had "no recovery". A recovery is now a location.reload( call (blanks allowed) or an
assignment to location.href (not ==/===).

WARN  lint-spa-poll-no-recovery  @DIR@/Space.js:2  setInterval/setTimeout poll loop 'poll()' reloads, but the recovery is not keyed on time since the last success (no lastOk* timestamp set from a clock in the poll body and compared) -- a failure-count or reload-on-error watchdog is blind to a hung request; key it on lastOkAt (types/dashboard.md Poll loop reliability)
